body: SANDALPHON, the immortal shade who traded part of his soul for eternity, leader of the Sidar in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human, becoming a shade; male; ageless, looking about forty; tall and upright. Unnaturally pale ash-grey skin, a long, smooth, clean-shaven face with high cheekbones, short smoke-grey hair swept back, dull grey eyes in which light never glints.
costume: a high-collared ash-grey robe over charcoal layers, fastened with dull silver clasps.
signature: He always wears a thin CIRCLET OF DULL PEWTER set with a single smoky grey stone that, like his eyes, gives back no light.
extra: He is a shade: wherever the light is weak his edges come apart, his shoulders, the ends of his sleeves and the hem of his clothes dissolving into soft grey mist that drifts off into the air, so it is hard to say where he stops and the air begins; his face always stays solid and clear. He feels almost nothing, and it shows: a smooth, relaxed face, level brows, a flat mouth, never a real smile, and no catchlight in his eyes.

vibes.name: Half a Soul
vibes.line: His right hand turning a page of a huge book, his left hand holding the facing page flat, that whole arm thinning into grey mist from the shoulder down; heavy-lidded eyes on the page, mouth flat; a silent library of a hidden Sidar city, flat grey daylight from high windows.
vibes.wears: the plain dress of the Grey: a high-collared ash-grey scholar's robe over charcoal layers, fastened with dull silver clasps.

vibes.name: Feels Nothing
vibes.line: His right hand holding a ripe peach to his nose as he breathes in and smells nothing, his left holding a full festival cup he has not touched; dull eyes level on nothing past the fruit; a lantern-hung street festival at dusk, warm light, dancers blurred behind him.
vibes.wears: festival finery a reveller pressed on him: a rich doublet of plum and gold brocade, a garland of orange marigolds hung around his neck.

vibes.name: Eternity's Price
vibes.line: His upturned right palm holding a curl of his own grey soul-smoke toward the viewer like a merchant's sample, his left holding an open, empty crystal phial at his side, waiting for yours; eyes level on the viewer; a bare ritual chamber underground at midnight, one cold white candle.
vibes.wears: the ritual robe of the Grey: long, plain bone-white silk with wide sleeves, a narrow black stole stitched with silver runes hanging to the hem.

vibes.name: Fog Walker
vibes.line: His right hand catching a gloved wrist thrust from the fog beside him, its dagger stopped, pointing away, his left holding a closed book to his chest; head not turned, eyes on the lane ahead, lips parted mid-word; a fog-choked lane at twilight, an amber street lamp making him solid.
vibes.wears: a long midnight-blue walking coat with a tall collar and a row of pewter buttons, a grey wool scarf wound once around his throat.
